We had a really great stay and would definitely recommend this hotel!

The room was very clean, well organised and comfortable, and everything was exactly as we expected. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly throughout our stay, and the access system with the entry code was very simple, convenient and made everything feel easy and secure.

Overall, we really enjoyed the practicality of the hotel, the cleanliness, the location and especially the excellent customer service. Everything worked perfectly from check-in to check-out.

I strongly advise against booking this hostel. My experience was shocking and unacceptable. First, they attempted to pressure me into booking directly through them instead of using Booking.com, likely to avoid the platform fees. When I refused and continued using Booking.com for the convenience of Afterpay, they retaliated. After booking my last day, I was abruptly kicked out in the middle of the day without any valid reason, and they refused to refund my money. To make matters worse, they called the police to forcefully remove my belongings and left them on the street. Now, I'm sitting outside with nowhere to stay.

They claimed my e-bike battery violated their rules, which is completely false—I never brought it inside. When I asked them to check the cameras, they changed their excuse to the amount of my luggage, even though I had already taken it out of their storage as they requested. Initially, they said the room was for luggage storage, but later they changed their story, saying it was their office and that I would need to pay for external storage. Despite their lies, they even posted a sign saying the room was for luggage, only to throw out my belongings.

The staff, especially one named Lizza, was exceptionally rude and seemed to enjoy threatening me. I wasn’t even given the opportunity to finish an important exam, causing me to fail. As an international student, this was devastating. The way they treated me was cruel, and I wouldn’t wish this experience on anyone.

This hostel not only disrespected me, but they also stole $74 from me for a night I never stayed, and they show no remorse. There are many better options in the area, like Mad Monkey Hostel. Do yourself a favor and avoid this place at all costs. They may respond to this review with a polite, dismissive response, but don’t be fooled—this is how they truly operate.
